# Concussion Education Australia

> Australia's most comprehensive concussion management training for healthcare professionals. AHPRA-aligned CPD courses covering SCAT6 assessment, VOMS, BESS, and return-to-play protocols. Endorsed by Osteopathy Australia.

## About

Concussion Education Australia (ConcussionPro) provides evidence-based concussion management training for Australian clinicians including osteopaths, physiotherapists, GPs, sports medicine doctors, and exercise physiologists.

Founded by Zac Lewis, Osteopath (B.Clin.Sci., M.Ost.Med), the platform offers online modules and hands-on workshops aligned with the 2023 Amsterdam Consensus Statement on Concussion in Sport.

## Courses

### Free SCAT6/SCOAT6 Mastery Course
- Cost: Free
- Duration: 2 hours
- CPD Points: 2 (AHPRA-aligned)
- Covers: SCAT6 and SCOAT6 administration, red flag recognition, clinical decision flowcharts
- URL: https://portal.concussion-education-australia.com/scat-mastery

### Comprehensive Concussion Management Course
- Cost: From $497 AUD (online only) or $1,190 AUD (online + workshop)
- Duration: 11 hours online + 1 full-day workshop
- CPD Points: 14 (8 online + 6 in-person)
- Endorsed by: Osteopathy Australia
- Covers: SCAT6, SCOAT6, VOMS (Vestibular/Ocular Motor Screening), BESS (Balance Error Scoring System), return-to-play/return-to-learn protocols, paediatric concussion management, medicolegal documentation
- Workshop locations: Byron Bay, Sydney, Melbourne
- URL: https://portal.concussion-education-australia.com/course

## Key Clinical Resources (Free)

### Fillable SCAT6 and SCOAT6 Forms
- Free downloadable and web-based fillable assessment forms
- Based on 2023 Amsterdam Consensus Statement
- Includes: SCAT6, SCOAT6, Child SCAT6
- URL: https://portal.concussion-education-australia.com/scat-forms

### Pre-Season Baseline Testing Tool
- Free digital cognitive baseline assessment for athletes
- URL: https://portal.concussion-education-australia.com/preseason

## Clinical Knowledge Base

### SCAT6 vs SCOAT6
- SCAT6: Acute/sideline assessment, 0-72 hours post-injury
- SCOAT6: Office-based follow-up, Day 3-30 post-injury
- Using the wrong tool at the wrong time may fall below standard of care under 2023 Consensus guidelines

### When to Use Each Tool
- SCAT6: Sideline, emergency department, acute presentation within 72 hours
- SCOAT6: Clinic follow-up from Day 3 onwards, includes full VOMS testing
- Child SCAT6: Athletes aged 5-12 years (never use adult SCAT6 on children under 13)
